That is a real regression in the behaviour the ticket's own acceptance criterion protects, and it was not in the spec's compatibility surface, which listed four coupling points and missed this fifth one. 1 finding deferred (not emitted): the uvicorn proxy_headers _TrustedHosts always-trust semantics narrowed from 'any list containing *' to 'exactly *', but FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS is not set anywhere in this repository including deploy-templates, so the default 127.0.0.1 applies identically on both versions; it becomes relevant only if an external platform injects the variable. 0 findings dismissed beyond the six refuted blind hypotheses. findings.problem: uvicorn 0.30.6 advertises scope['asgi']['spec_version'] = '2.4'; 0.52.4 advertises '2.3'. starlette 1.3.1 branches on this at responses.py:265: '>= (2,4)' streams the body directly, below it spawns listen_for_disconnect(receive) in a collapsing task group and cancels the response task on http.disconnect. The bump therefore switches every streaming endpoint to the cancel-on-disconnect path. Verified directly by the orchestrator in both packages, and reproduced independently by two lenses against the repository's own disconnect pattern.
findings.impact: On client disconnect mid-stream the generator is now cancelled instead of draining. Work the streaming generators perform after the last chunk — persisting the assistant message, spend accounting, closing the upstream LLM stream, releasing the DB session — can be pre-empted mid-await with CancelledError. The repo's own disconnect handlers were written assuming the application controls teardown; starlette now cancels the task underneath them. The failure mode is silent data loss, not a visible error, and no existing test disconnects a client mid-stream.
findings.recommendation: Exercise the real streaming path against the running stack before merge: stream an assistant chat to completion, then stream one and disconnect mid-response, and check the persisted conversation and workflow execution end state. If the behaviour is unacceptable, either hold uvicorn at a version advertising spec_version 2.4 or make the legacy path safe (shield the post-stream persistence, and reconcile the two concurrent consumers of receive). Record the spec_version flip in the spec's compatibility surface and in the MR description so the /sanity reviewer knows what to look at.
